title: Mt.FUJI 100 — ACCESS (access and official tour pages)
claims: For 2027 the event loop bus runs Fujisan Station to Fuji Resort Hotel, the Fujikyu Highland express bus stop and Fuji Hokuroku Park second parking lot, passing Kawaguchiko Station only during the 00:00-07:00 loop on 25 April.
The 2027 loop bus fares are 3,800 yen for a three-day ticket, 2,700 yen for a two-day ticket and 2,200 yen for a one-day ticket, all tax included, with sales starting on 29 January 2027.
The 2027 loop bus runs on 23 April from 7:30 to 19:45, on 24 April from 02:00 to 24:00 and on 25 April from 00:00 to 16:00, roughly hourly with a bus every 30 minutes at peak times.
There is no parking for athletes at the finish venue, Fuji Hokuroku Park, and parking is reservation-only with tickets sold in advance.
The official access tour for the 2026 race is sold by Fujikyu Travel as a package tour, and all plans require advance reservation.
The 2026 official tour includes a stay at PICA Fujiyoshida, about seven minutes on foot from the finish venue, with check-in from 10:00 to 19:00 and check-out by 11:00.

The 2026 official tour also includes a plan to stay in Fuji City the night before, with race check-in and gear check at a special venue in Fuji City from 18:00 to 22:30 and a bus to the start venue the next day.

The 2026 official tour sells buses from Shinjuku and Yokohama that stop at the check-in venue and then continue to the start at Fujisan Kodomo no Kuni, leaving Shinjuku at 9:00 and Yokohama at 8:30, arriving at Fuji Hokuroku Park around 11:00 and at the start venue around 15:30.
The 2026 official tour sells shuttle buses from Fuji Hokuroku Park and from the athlete parking lots to the start venue between 13:00 and 14:00, arriving between 14:30 and 15:30.
The 2026 official tour includes a supported tour for runners who cannot arrange their own support crew, with dedicated staff at four aid stations and the official support bag.

The 2026 tour page states that some plans go on sale on 3 December at 12:00 and that the loop bus, athlete parking tickets and the Fuji Hokuroku Park to Kodomo no Kuni shuttle go on sale on 29 January at 12:00.
